purpose.summary: This program (ORCHCM31) is part of the JMA ORCA standard medical receipt software system. It appears to generate a daily payment/receipt certificate report (支払証明書・日別), processing patient insurance combination data and collection master records to produce printed output organized by inpatient/outpatient classification and date ranges.
purpose.domain: healthcare/medical billing (Japanese medical insurance claims processing)

notable_features: Japanese-language comments encoded in Latin-1 (actually EUC-JP or Shift-JIS, decoded as Latin-1 causing mojibake)
COPY statements referencing many external copybooks (HCM31G.INC, HCM31N.INC, CPSYSKANRI.INC, CPSK1001.INC, etc.)
LINKAGE SECTION with multiple USING parameters (SPA-AREA, ORCSPRTAREA, ORCHCM31AREA)
Database cursor open/fetch/close pattern via MCP-TABLE/MCP-PATHNAME mechanism (custom DB abstraction, no EXEC SQL)
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS — uses proprietary DB access layer
